snippet.title: Toward From: Liquid Understanding
snippet.description:
Gameplay footage of my game poems issue 1 submission















in the interplay of z loving planes
in the rules that govern the turning stars
In the cadence of the fog pouring from my sleeping mouth
In the backwards steps towards a mirror
In the stillness of an answerless riddle
in the cool atoms of a sacred froth
in the lilting steps away from outed shucksters
in the frictive sparks of adherance to traditional form
In the boldest cackling rejection of stern reality
In the worldless poems of wartime fertilizer
